title: Readable User Briefs
summary: Plain-English brief layer for readers who want the machine output translated into what matters, why it matters, what proves it and what to open next.

sections.title: What matters today
sections.body: Start with the strongest route, the highest clock, the top capital lane and the most important missing record. These are the quickest paths to understanding the structure.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: The site is not only tracking names. It is tracking how money, policy, contracts, ownership, votes, institutions and records connect.

sections.title: What proves it
sections.body: A claim becomes stronger when it has filings, official records, contracts, court records, proxy-voting records, public mandates or dated primary sources.

sections.title: What to open first
sections.body: Open Daily Power Conclusions, then Evidence Graph, then the entity or company page, then Missing Records if the claim still needs proof.

topRoutes.title: Strongest route today
topRoutes.text: World Economic Forum is the strongest current map node because it has the highest combined route, evidence and brain score.

topRoutes.title: Top capital lane
topRoutes.text: BlackRock should be watched through AUM, holdings, proxy voting, mandates and public filings.

topRoutes.title: Top contractor lane
topRoutes.text: Blackwater / Xe / Academi / Constellis lineage is the strongest contractor watch route in current data.

topRoutes.title: Top institution lane
topRoutes.text: World Bank is the strongest institution route in current data.

topRoutes.title: Top billionaire lane
topRoutes.text: Elon Musk is the strongest elite-network route in current data.

topRoutes.title: Most important missing record
topRoutes.text: Health and Human Services Department needs: Confirm the primary record page, PDF, docket, filing, award notice or registry record..
